notes: Ruka 0.4.4: compaction reliability. Each compaction now builds two summaries over different fact windows and reconciles facts that only the second pass retained. A deterministic quiz checks the final summary for the goal, rules, plan, next action and exact strings, and adds a CONTEXT WARNING if any check fails. Adds a 6-round repeated-compaction drift benchmark and npm run check:memory. Measured: canary retention 100%, quiz 100%, drift 80% after 6 rounds against a 90% target. The 90% target is not met; the 80% safety floor is met.
